description:
Create a shopping cart in Demo Store. Returns a cart_id. Pass it as cart_id to get_shipping_rates, select_shipping_option, apply_discount and preview_checkout; complete_checkout and get_trust_receipt take the same value as checkout_session_id.

KYA IDENTITY: a Skyfire kya token has no effect on this tool (it grants no trust boost here); KYA identity applies to the REST agent API (`Authorization: Bearer`), not to the MCP tools. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout. CREDENTIAL: this store needs one. Call the `create_sandbox_key` tool first (it is in this tool list and needs no credential), then pass the key you get back as the `agent_key` argument — or as an `Authorization: Bearer` header if your client can set headers. Do not ask a person to log in: there is no human login for this store.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

agent_session_id.description: Opaque agent session identifier for cart resume across sessions

agent_token.description: JWS compact (EdDSA/Ed25519) signed by the agent. Required for Shopify enforcement rules R001/R002/R004. A malformed token fails with AGENT_TOKEN_INVALID on any platform. On Shopify stores Trusteed also verifies the signature on receipt against a registered key that must belong to the calling agent (otherwise AGENT_TOKEN_INVALID and no cart is created), and the checkout Function verifies it again offline at payment. On other platforms Trusteed checks its structure only and forwards it to the store.

display_context.description: Agent display capability: webview (browser) or headless

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED for this write unless sent as the `Idempotency-Key` header or `params._meta["trusteed/idempotency-key"]`. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

variant_id.description: Variant ID (optional). Must match a variant id listed by get_product_details; an unknown id is rejected rather than silently replaced by the default variant.

name: create_cart

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which this checkout SESSION stops being usable. It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

expires_in_seconds.description: Whole seconds left on this checkout SESSION at response time (0 when already past). It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.
